messages:
raj: heads-up: onboarding sampleapp stream goes silent ~30s in, client stays OPEN and never reconnects. seen on mac+ci runner.
ellie: which sampleapp / sdk?
raj: node quickstart (eventsource-polyfill). repro on Chrome and our headless runner. no console errors, just silence. :confused:
samir: sounds like keepalive vs auth refresh interplay. did proxy send a 401 or close?
raj: no 401s. local runner logs around stall:
raj: ```
[2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] stream: send keepalive
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: start refresh
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] proxy: upgrade ok
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] stream: received blank chunk (empty lines)
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh done
[2026-03-17T21:03:45Z] stream: no data for 10s, client still reports OPEN
[2026-03-17T21:03:50Z] stream: client has no new events
```
ellie: blank chunk meaning lone CRLFs. our SSE parser treats that as keepalive comment, but if the proxy pauses the TCP stream during auth refresh we sometimes merge the blank lines with the next data frame and drop the former last-event-id. that clobbers reassembly logic.
raj: so the socket doesn't close and EventSource doesn't reconnect — app sees nothing. any quick mitigation?
samir: client-side watchdog. track last event timestamp, if > (2x keepalive) do es.close() and recreate EventSource. small change to sampleapp.
ellie: can you paste sample snippet?
raj: current minimal sample:
raj: ```js
const es = new EventSource(url);
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data);
es.onopen = () => console.log('open');
es.onerror = () => console.log('err');
```
raj: no watchdog at the moment.
samir: patch idea: setInterval to check Date.now() - lastSeen; if > threshold then es.close(); es = new EventSource(url); simple and effective.
ellie: also add README note: "If you hit silent stalls during onboarding, enable WATCHDOG or increase keepalive interval." I'll draft that.
raj: could server help? maybe emit explicit SSE comment when we start auth refresh so clients see activity: e.g., ":auth-refresh start" and ":auth-refresh end".
samir: server signal is handy but brittle across proxies. prefer client watchdog + a defensive server comment.
devex-bot: @samir opened PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/512 adding watchdog + README note.
ellie: please also add a tiny CI integration test that simulates interleaved blank chunk during auth refresh and asserts client reconnects. a netcat-based test could inject delay/blank lines.
raj: adding logs and a minimal repro script to the PR. i'll include sample runner commands for local debug.
samir: i'll add a flaky-tolerant netcat test and a note in docs about client libs that collapse blank lines vs keepalive.
ellie: merging README+watchdog once CI passes. closing onboarding ticket after staging deploy. :white_check_mark:
raj: thanks all — this saved my onboarding call earlier.
